trainer/30344.htm.text: Magister Rohmer: Magic has its source in the elements you see, but it takes a lifetime of mastery to learn their secrets. Eh? You wanted my attention?

trainer/30344-noteach.htm.text: Magister Rohmer: Friend, you seem to be contemplating stealing my fine skills with rather thin trickery. Looking at your face, I don't think you can memorize the thick magic book, and your thick hands are too clumsy to take care of magic materials of great delicacy ... Nobody can fool Rohmer.

Q00038_DragonFangs/30344-01.html.text: Magister Rohmer: Let me read the letter from Magister Iris. It seems the Langk lizardmen in the south have obtained some very powerful sorcery. Take the notes I've collected in this letter back to Iris, she'll need them to complete her work.

Q00038_DragonFangs/30344-04.html.text: Magister Rohmer: Follow this road southwest to Gludin Village, you'll find Magister Iris there. This sorcery grows stronger by the day, you should hurry!

Q00298_LizardmensConspiracy/30344-01.htm.text: Magister Rohmer: It seems like I've been waiting forever for the Patrol's Report ! Hmm... I've heard that the Maille Lizardmen have control of Araneid! Will you help me? This is no ordinary mission! In fact, it's too dangerous for me to do it myself... Are you up for a real challenge?

Q10276_MutatedKaneusGludio/30344-02.htm.text: Magister Rohmer: This is it. Tissue samples of the mutated Kaneus! Now we can move forward with our study about the mutated Kaneus and the nature of Kamaloka. Soon we will discover their underlying nature! This is only the beginning of a long journey to find the truth.

Q10276_MutatedKaneusGludio/30344-01.htm.text: Magister Rohmer: I heard about you from Captain Bathis. You're the one who helped the Sages of Magic study the mutated Kaneus in Kamaloka, aren't you? I can now you now that our study is not limited simply to those mutants. Actually, Kamaloka itself is an omen of impending crisis and chaos. Others …

Q00038_DragonFangs/30344-02.html.text: Magister Rohmer: Don't lose this letter, it's the only copy! It's very urgent, you must hurry!

Q00038_DragonFangs/30344-03.html.text: Magister Rohmer: Something's missing. The letter I gave you is useless without the sample I enclosed in it. You'd better bring it back.

Q00298_LizardmensConspiracy/30344-04.htm.text: Magister Rohmer: Lizardmen are using sorcery to turn arachnids into servants! To dispell it, I'll need the orbs they are using. Get shiny colored orbs from Maille Lizardman Warriors, Shamans and Matriarchs . Poison spiders and giant spiders have shiny red colored orbs . I need fifty of each. Find t…

Q00298_LizardmensConspiracy/30344-05.htm.text: Magister Rohmer: Bring me the scout's report from Guard Praga !

Q00298_LizardmensConspiracy/30344-06.htm.text: Magister Rohmer: I, Rohmer, thank you for your help. Now, I can weaken the power of the Maille Lizardmen's magic even further. But the fight is not over yet. The Maille Lizardmen outnumber us and have countless shamans. They will endlessly try to strengthen and recover their magic. To prevent this,…

Q00298_LizardmensConspiracy/30344-07.htm.text: Magister Rohmer: Rohmer says that this amount is not going to help us that much. You must collect 50 shiny five-colored beads and 50 shiny red beads and come back.

Q10276_MutatedKaneusGludio/30344-03.htm.text: Magister Rohmer: Yes. The journey to reveal the truth about Kamaloka and Kaneus can now begin in earnest thanks to the tissue samples you provided. links.text: Ask about the Agathion in charge of skill enchantment.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
